cards.name: Fremen

cards.name: Harkonnen Heavy 'Thopter
cards.text: friendly harkonnen trooper units gain raid 1.

cards.name: Scouting 'Thopter
cards.text:
raid 1
when played/on attack: look at the top card of any player's deck. you may discard it.

cards.name: Strike 'Thopter
cards.text: when played: you may deal 1 damage to a ground unit.

cards.name: Carryall
cards.text: when played/on attack: you may play a ground vehicle unit from your discard pile that was defeated this phase and costs #5 or less for free.

cards.name: Spice Harvester
cards.text:
when played/on attack: if you control an arrakis base, create a spice token.

when the regroup phase starts: you may defeat 3 friendly spice tokens. if you do, put the top card of your deck into play as a resource.

cards.name: Gene Manipulation
cards.text: when played: choose a card in your discard pile that shares a trait with attached unit. attached unit gains a keyword printed on that card.

cards.name: Personal Shield
cards.text:
attach to a friendly unit.
when played: if you control an arrakis base, defeat this unit, otherwise give a shield token to attached unit.
when the regroup phase starts: if attached unit has no shield, give a shield token to it.

cards.name: Bene Gesserit Sister
cards.text:
when played: choose one:
- you may deal 2 damage to a unit.
- the next bene gesserit card you play this phase cost 2 less.

cards.name: The Shield Wall
cards.text:
fortify
attached base gains: "enemy ground units get -1/-0 while attacking bases. 
your units can't be defeated by enemy shai-hulud card abilities."

cards.name: Bene Gesserit Initiate
cards.text: when played: each opponent discards a card from their hand.

cards.name: Shai-Hulud
cards.text:
overwhelm
when played: while you control an arrakis base, defeat all other non-fremen ground units.
when this unit completes an attack: return it to the bottom of its owner's deck.

cards.name: Hunter Seeker
cards.text:
#elusive (can't be chosen as a target for an attack.)
saboteur
when a non-leader ground unit enters play: arrow and defeat this unit. if you do, deal 3 damage to that unit.

cards.name: Gom Jabbar
cards.text:
attach to a non-vehicle, non leader unit.

attached unit gains: "when this unit exhaust, defeat this unit".

cards.subtitle: Haunted by Dreams
cards.text:
you mean look at the top card of your deck at any time.

action arrow: discard a card from your deck. you may give a unit with the same cost +1/+1 for this phase. on attack: look at the top 3 cards of your deck and discard one. gain the on attack ability of the card or one of its keywords for this phase.

cards.name: Crysknife
cards.text:
attach to a non-vehicle unit.

if attached unit is a fremen it gains saboteur.
